{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove refunded orders (they are not real revenue)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("\nCustomer segment by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)

# Check average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Final comparison: conversion rate and revenue
print("\nSummary:")
print(f"Email channel conversion rate: {conversion_rate_by_channel['email']:.3f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']:.3f}")
print(f"Email average revenue: ${avg_revenue_by_channel['email']:.2f}")
print(f"Paid search average revenue: ${avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']:.2f}")"}
